title: Long-time asymptotics for the heat kernel and for heat equation solutions on homogeneous trees
summary: We study the large-time behavior of the continuous-time heat kernel and of solutions to the heat equation on homogeneous trees. First, we derive sharp asymptotic formulas for the heat kernel as $t\to\infty$. Second, using them, we show that solutions with initial data in weighted $\ell^1$ classes, asymptotically factorize in $\ell^p$ norms, $p\in[1,\infty]$, as the product of the heat kernel, times a $p$-mass function, dependent on the initial condition and $p$.
